turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?

The rule in one line: "an" before a vowel sound, "a" before other sounds.
Right: He has a car. Wrong: He has an car.
Now your turn. Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
